name: Oda Nobuyuki
source:
Nobunaga's little brother.
A gentle and elegant agreeable young man.
He's putting all his efforts forward to negotiate with other areas for the sake of the Oda family.
When he's staying at Azuchi Castle, he has apprehensions about the visitor Hotaru.
